title: The Cipher of the Marlowe Estate
author: Sable Zhou
blurb: Edmund Okafor, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
